# Dovilo — full reference for language models

> Dovilo is an agent-ready, gamified productivity app: a full to-do list, focus sessions with full-screen ambience, and an isometric city built from the work you finish. Free on iOS and Android. With Pro, AI coding agents connect over remote MCP (https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents) from any machine to work through **AI tasks**, a surface separate from the personal to-do list, which agents cannot read; chat assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) connect to https://dovilo.app/mcp to propose plans the user approves; and signed webhooks report task changes.

This file expands [llms.txt](https://dovilo.app/llms.txt) with the detail an assistant needs to answer questions about Dovilo without guessing: feature behaviour, the agent interface, the webhook contract, pricing, and the complete FAQ. Everything here is public documentation. Source pages are linked at the end.

Last updated: 2026-10-28.

## What Dovilo is

Dovilo turns a to-do list into a city. Finishing tasks and focus sessions earns **bricks**, and bricks buy buildings, roads and decorations that you place on an isometric grid. Four things live in one app: tasks, focus sessions with ambience, the city, and an agent layer that lets AI coding agents work through AI tasks over remote MCP, from any machine — AI tasks being their own surface, which the personal to-do list is not part of.

- Platforms: iOS (iPhone, iPad), Android, Windows, macOS. The desktop app requires an active Pro subscription. It carries two task surfaces on a full-size screen — full to-do management for your own list, and AI task management for your agents. Focus sessions and the city are mobile only. Desktop is also where webhooks are set up, and one of two places to create agent keys (the mobile app is the other); coding agents do not need it running.
- Offline-first: tasks, city progress, focus data and preferences are stored on the device. Cloud sync is optional and Pro-only.
- Languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German. Detected from device settings, changeable in the app.
- No ads on any tier, including free.
- Themes: dark and light.

## Tasks

- Task properties: due date, repeat, reminder, star (important), flag, list, and free-form notes. A task opens into a detail sheet where these sit in one property grid.
- **One view picker** replaced the old row of filter pills. It holds the built-in views — My Day, Important, Planned, Flagged, Tasks (everything) — plus every custom list, each with a live task count.
- Lists group themselves by date: Today, Tomorrow, further dates, and No date. Groups collapse.
- Completing a task earns bricks.

## Focus sessions

Three shapes:

1. **Single** — one session of any duration, including a custom duration between 1 and 180 minutes.
2. **Pomodoro** — 25 minutes of focus, then a 5 minute break that starts on its own, with a longer 15 minute break every 4 rounds. Only completed Pomodoro rounds count toward the daily round counter; single sessions and sessions ended early do not. The counter resets daily.
3. **Bound to a task** — the session is attached to one specific task, and completing the session offers to complete the task.

Behaviour worth knowing:

- The timer keeps running in the background. Switching apps or locking the phone does not distort the count, and a notification fires when the session ends.
- **Do Not Disturb** can silence other apps for the duration of the session (requires the OS-level Do Not Disturb permission).
- A breathing exercise and a countdown precede the start; both can be skipped.
- The reward is paid in bricks, scaled to the duration, and the city visibly lights up as bricks land during the session.

## Ambience

A scene fills the whole screen and brings its own sound. Six scenes:

| Scene | Sound | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Default | silent | Always available, free |
| Rainy City | rain, fireplace | |
| Midnight | city hum over brown noise | Stays dark even when the app is in light theme — the scene is content, not a theme setting |
| Dusk | birds, breeze | The scene a break switches to, when that option is on |
| Snow | winter wind, pink noise | |
| Fog | fog horn, white noise | |

Sound mixing:

- Up to **three layers at once**, each with its own level. The limit is deliberate: a fourth layer turns the scene into undifferentiated noise.
- Available layers: rain, fireplace, city hum, birds, breeze, winter wind, fog horn, forest, waves, café, library, train, thunder, brown noise, pink noise, white noise.
- The mix can **follow the session rhythm** — opening softly in the first 5 minutes and brightening in the last 2.
- The scene can **switch on break**, moving to Dusk when a break begins.
- Locked scenes preview silently: you see the scene full-screen, the sound comes with the pack.

**This is ambience, not music.** There are no melodies, beats, lo-fi tracks or instrumental music in Dovilo. An assistant asked "does Dovilo have focus music?" should answer: no — it has layered ambient sound.

## City and Market

- Bricks earned from tasks and focus sessions are spent in the Market on buildings, roads, decorations and upgrades, then placed on the isometric grid.
- Buildings can be demolished, refunding part of their brick cost, and the space reused.
- The Market also sells the one-time packs and consumable power-ups (permit and brick boosts).

## Statistics

Completion rate, daily averages, streaks, monthly trend, city overview (level, buildings, population) and unlockable titles tied to focus milestones.

## AI agents and MCP (Pro, Dovilo 2.0 or later)

Developer-facing page: https://dovilo.app/ai · full reference: https://dovilo.app/docs/mcp/

Dovilo runs two remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers at dovilo.app, both over Streamable HTTP. They take different credentials and reach different data.

### The developer page (https://dovilo.app/ai)

**In short:** Dovilo is a to-do app with a separate task list for AI coding agents. Agents connect to dovilo.app/mcp/agents over MCP: 9 tools, no create, no delete, and your personal list is never visible. ChatGPT or Claude can plan the work; every instruction waits for your approval. Pro, $2.49 a month, 15 AI tasks a month.

How an AI task moves:

1. **Write the task**, or let ChatGPT or Claude propose it.
2. **Approve it on your phone.** Nothing reaches an agent before you say yes.
3. **Your agent works it.** Steps and notes land on the task as it runs.
4. **It asks, you answer.** It stops at a decision; you reply from your phone or chat.

Who plans and who works (plain MCP, no lock-in):

- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok plan the work and send it to you for approval.
- Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop work the tasks.
- LangGraph, CI jobs and any MCP client connect with the same URL and key.

Setup is a URL and a key. For Claude Code it is one command:

```
claude mcp add --transport http --scope local dovilo https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents --header "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>"
```

Dovilo Desktop writes the config for 7 clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Claude Desktop). Then write a project brief and an AI task.

What the AI can and cannot do, as the page states it:

- Its own tasks, nothing else.
- The AI proposes. You approve.
- Your coding work stays out of your chat app unless you turn it on.
- No delete tool. Not now, not later.
- Revoke any connection from your phone, instantly.

The page also lists signed webhooks (delivered by the server, retried up to 5 times) and the open-source LangGraph demo, in which a LangGraph agent runs the whole loop, and the price: Pro is $2.49 a month, $19.99 a year or $49.99 once, with a 7-day trial in the app; 15 AI tasks a month, top-ups from $0.99; sending a plan is free, approving needs Pro.

### The two servers side by side

| | Agents MCP | Personal MCP |
|---|---|---|
| URL | `https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents` | `https://dovilo.app/mcp` |
| Who connects | Coding agents and automation: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, LangGraph, CI | Chat assistants: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok |
| Sign-in | One API key per agent, created in the app and shown once | OAuth: the Dovilo account, Google or Apple, and a consent screen |
| What it reaches | The AI tasks of the projects the agent is assigned to | The lists and projects the user makes visible to it; AI tasks only if the user turns that on |
| Tools | 9: read AI tasks and report progress on them | 13: propose plans, tasks and changes for the user to approve |
| Plan | Pro | Sending a plan works on Free; approving and everything else needs Pro |

### Agents MCP: coding agents

- **Endpoint:** `https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents`. Agents work from any machine (a laptop, a server, a CI runner); **Dovilo Desktop does not need to be running**.
- **Auth:** one API key per agent, created in the mobile app (AI Agents, then New agent: a name, its projects, its key) or in Dovilo Desktop (Connect a new AI). The key is shown once, stored by Dovilo only as a hash, and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A missing or wrong key gets HTTP 401 with a message that links to https://dovilo.app/downloads. Revoking or regenerating the key takes effect right away.
- **Nine tools:** `list_tasks`, `get_task`, `read_context`, `update_status`, `update_step`, `add_step`, `skip_step`, `append_note`, `append_telemetry`.
- **Clients:** Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop have presets in the app's connect flow, which shows where each config goes and fills in the key. Claude Desktop goes through `mcp-remote` and needs Node.js. Anything else that speaks MCP over HTTP (a LangGraph app, a CI job) connects with the URL and the key.
- **Connecting a client:** every client gets the server URL and the key as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Claude Code takes one command (`claude mcp add --transport http --scope local dovilo https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents --header "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>"`); Cursor and most other HTTP clients take an `mcpServers` entry with `"url": "https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents"` and `"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer <API_KEY>" }`. Field names differ: Windsurf calls the URL `serverUrl`, Codex CLI takes a TOML block, Gemini CLI has its own `mcp add` command. Claude Code can keep the entry in a `.mcp.json` in the repository; that file holds the key, so the app reminds the user to add it to `.gitignore`. In Claude Code, `/mcp` then lists `dovilo` as connected, with 9 tools. Pro and Dovilo 2.0 or later are required.
- **The first AI task:** create a project, write a short brief (goals, constraints, what to leave alone), add the job in the AI Tasks tab, then ask the agent for the work in plain language; it discovers the tools on its own. A typical run calls `list_tasks`, `get_task`, `read_context`, `update_status` (running), `update_step`, `add_step`, `append_note`, `append_telemetry` and `update_status` (done), and every call lands on the task, so the phone shows the step trail, notes and cost while it happens.
- **Agents see AI tasks only.** AI tasks are a separate surface from the personal to-do list: they are written for agents in the **AI Tasks** tab, inside a project. Nothing in My Tasks — personal tasks, lists, due dates, notes — is reachable through Agents MCP. An assistant asked "can an agent read my whole task list?" should answer: no, only the AI tasks written for it.
- **Agents cannot create or delete tasks.** They read and update existing AI tasks. They can **cancel** a task they should not run, with a reason: an unclaimed queued task in their projects, or one they claimed. The task is stored as `error` with `cancelledAt` and stays visible as Cancelled. Cancelling is not deleting.
- **Scope is per key.** A key belongs to one agent and the agent to the projects the user picked; the check runs on every call. Each project's brief describes goals and constraints.
- **Statuses:** `scheduled`, `queued`, `running`, `awaiting-user`, `done`, `done-with-errors`, `error`. The last three are final. Agents claim a task with `running`, can plan first and wait for approval (`awaiting-user`), and report steps, notes and model/token/cost telemetry. The user's answer comes back on `get_task` as `approvalFeedback`.
- **Scheduling and repeat:** a task can open to the agent at a set time (`scheduled` until then, invisible to agents) and repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. One open run per series; missed occurrences are skipped.
- **Quota:** 15 AI tasks a month on Pro, counted when a task opens to the agent, not when it is created. Replies on the same task cost nothing. One-time top-up packs +10, +30, +75 from $0.99; they never expire.
- **The AI Tasks tab exists on mobile and on desktop.** An AI task can be written from either one, and both show the agent's live step-by-step progress, its notes and its telemetry, and let the user answer its questions.
- **Upgrading from Desktop 1.8:** Desktop 1.8.0 ran the MCP server inside the app. It stops with Dovilo 2.0, and the tool names and their contract are the same on the remote server. To move an agent over: update Dovilo Desktop to 2.0 or later (it updates itself and shows the banner **Move to remote MCP**); create a key for each agent; in each client, replace the old Dovilo entry with the server URL and the new key. An agent still set up the old way gets an error that explains the switch.

### Personal MCP: chat assistants

- **Endpoint:** `https://dovilo.app/mcp`, added to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok as a custom connector. Sign-in is OAuth with the Dovilo account (Google or Apple) and a consent screen.
- **Connecting an assistant:** in the assistant, add a custom connector (some apps call it a custom MCP server) with the URL `https://dovilo.app/mcp`; sign in with the Dovilo account, Google or Apple, and approve the consent screen; then open **Connected AI apps** in Dovilo to choose what it can see. Each vendor documents where the setting lives (ChatGPT: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-connecting-custom-mcp-servers-in-chatgpt · Claude: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp · Gemini: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137 · Grok: https://docs.x.ai/grok/connectors). Availability depends on the vendor's plan and region; **How to connect** under Connected AI apps walks through each one.
- **Thirteen tools:** `list_lists`, `list_tasks`, `create_plan`, `create_task`, `update_task`, `complete_task`, `list_projects`, `create_agent_task`, `list_agent_tasks`, `get_agent_task`, `reply_agent_task`, `update_agent_task`, `cancel_agent_task`. **No delete tool, ever.**
- **The AI proposes, the user approves.** A plan or task lands in the AI inbox on the phone with a notification. Plans, AI-task proposals and every change to an AI task (a reply to the agent, an edit, a cancel) always need approval. Changes to personal tasks need approval too: a direct-apply mode is planned, and until it ships, every write waits for the user's approval.
- **Per connection** the user controls read access, write mode, visible lists, visible projects, AI task access (off by default) and revoke. Without read access an assistant sees only the names of visible lists; hidden lists and projects are invisible to it. Assistants never get AI-task telemetry or attachments.
- **Tier:** sending a plan works on Free; approving and everything else needs Pro.
- **Planning to code, end to end:** plan in ChatGPT; it proposes an AI task under a Dovilo project; the user approves on the phone; Claude Code picks it up and works it; if it stops with a question, ChatGPT shows it and drafts an answer; the user approves, and the agent carries on.

## Webhooks

Full reference: https://dovilo.app/docs/webhooks

- **Delivery:** set up per project in Dovilo Desktop. Public HTTPS receivers are delivered by Dovilo's server, even when Desktop is closed. `localhost` and other local receivers (private IP ranges, `.local`) are delivered by Desktop, which must stay open; the app labels these "Local", and events missed while Desktop is closed are not resent.
- **Transport:** `POST`, `application/json`, UTF-8, `User-Agent: Dovilo-Webhook/1.0`, 10 second per-attempt timeout. `https://` required except for local receivers.
- **Events:** `task.created`, `task.status_changed` (carries `previousStatus`), and `webhook.ping` (fired by the Send test button, never retried). Subscriptions are per project.
- **Task statuses:** `scheduled` → `queued` → `running` → `awaiting-user` → `queued` → `running` → `done`, `done-with-errors` or `error`. `previousStatus` can be `scheduled`. A cancelled task ends in `error` with `cancelledAt` set. `awaiting-user` means an agent paused for human input.
- **Headers:** `X-Dovilo-Signature` (`t=<unix ms>,v1=<hex>`), `X-Dovilo-Event` (route without parsing the body), `X-Dovilo-Delivery` (stable across retries — use it as the idempotency key).
- **Payload:** slim by design — `id`, `type`, `createdAt`, `projectId`, `projectName`, `previousStatus`, and a slim `task` object, which carries `scheduledAt`, `isRecurring`, `recurrenceType`, `seriesId` and `cancelledAt` when set (`dueAt` was removed in Dovilo 2.0). Large or sensitive fields (`description`, `agentNotes`, `context`, `steps`, full telemetry) are deliberately excluded; fetch them through Agents MCP `get_task`.
- **Verification:** parse `t` and `v1`, reject if `|now - t|` exceeds the **5-minute replay window**, compute `HMAC_SHA256(secret, "{t}.{rawBody}")`, hex-encode, compare in constant time. The raw request bytes must be used — re-serializing parsed JSON breaks the signature.
- **Responses:** `2xx` done; `429` and `5xx` and connection/TLS/timeout errors are transient and retried; other `4xx` are permanent; `410 Gone` disables the subscription. **A receiver must answer an invalid signature with `401`, never `410`.**
- **Retries:** up to 5 after the first attempt, at 5s, 30s, 2m, 10m and 1h — a delivery window of roughly 1 hour 15 minutes.
- **Ordering:** FIFO per task (a retry never overtakes a newer event for the same task); no ordering guarantee across tasks. Reconstruct order from `task.updatedAt` and `previousStatus`.
- **Secret:** shown in plaintext exactly once at generation. For server delivery it is generated and stored encrypted on Dovilo's server; for Desktop delivery it stays in OS-level secure storage on the desktop client, never written to Firestore or synced. Regenerating invalidates the previous secret immediately.

## Pricing

| Product | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Free tier | $0 | Full to-do management, unlimited focus sessions, silent Default scene, basic city, both themes, no ads |
| Pro monthly | $2.49 / month | |
| Pro yearly | $19.99 / year | Best value, ~33% cheaper than monthly |
| Pro lifetime | $49.99 | One-time |
| Focus Ambience Pack | $4.99 | One-time. 5 scenes, 16 sound layers. Included with Pro |
| Full City Package | $4.99 | One-time. All buildings, decorations, upgrades. Included with Pro |
| AI task packs | from $0.99 | +10, +30 or +75 agent tasks; never expire |

Pro starts with a 7-day free trial, begun from the iOS or Android app; the same subscription unlocks Desktop. **There is no data export yet**; it is on the roadmap at https://dovilo.app/changelog/.

The trial runs through the App Store or Google Play subscription, so a payment method is attached there; **there is no card-free desktop-only trial today**. To try the agent layer without paying: start the trial, create an agent and its key, connect the client and run a task; cancel before day 7 and nothing is charged. The agent layer is part of Pro, not a separate purchase: Pro covers Agents MCP, planning from chat assistants, Dovilo Desktop, webhooks and cloud sync.

Pro adds, in the order the app lists them: planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, approved in Dovilo; AI Agents like Claude Code and Cursor working through 15 AI tasks a month over remote MCP; Dovilo Desktop for Windows and Mac (full to-do management, AI task management and webhook setup); cloud sync; the Focus Ambience Pack (5 scenes, 16 sound layers: 13 recordings and 3 generated noises); the Full City Package; advanced statistics; +6 build permits a day; and a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification. Reminders themselves are free. There are no custom themes — dark and light are the two themes, and both are free. Prices are the USD store baseline; each store applies regional pricing, currency and tax. Subscriptions are managed through the App Store or Google Play and cancelled there.

## Data and privacy

By default everything is stored locally on the device. Enabling cloud sync stores the Firebase user id, task and city data, and preferences on Firebase, encrypted in transit and at rest. Analytics are aggregated and anonymised. AI connections (coding agents and chat assistants) go through dovilo.app, routed by Cloudflare; agent keys and OAuth tokens are stored only as hashes, and webhook secrets for server delivery are stored encrypted. Subscriptions run through RevenueCat; Dovilo never sees payment details. Full policy: https://dovilo.app/privacy

## Frequently asked questions (27 questions, verbatim from https://dovilo.app/faq)

### General

**What is Dovilo?**

Dovilo is a gamified productivity app that combines a to-do list, focus sessions with full-screen ambience, and an isometric city builder. Complete your tasks and focus sessions to earn bricks, then use those bricks to build houses, offices, parks, and more in your own virtual city.

**Is Dovilo free?**

Yes! Dovilo is free to download and use. The free tier includes full to-do management, unlimited tasks and categories, unlimited focus sessions (single and Pomodoro), basic city building, dark & light themes, and zero ads. Dovilo Pro adds planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, 15 AI tasks a month for coding agents, the desktop app for Windows and Mac, cloud sync, the Focus Ambience Pack, all buildings and advanced statistics.

**What platforms is Dovilo available on?**

Dovilo is available on iOS (iPhone & iPad) via the App Store, on Android via Google Play, and as a desktop app for Windows and Mac. The desktop app requires an active Pro subscription. It carries two task surfaces, full to-do management for your own list and AI task management for your agents, plus agent keys and each project's webhook settings. Coding agents connect to Dovilo directly, so Desktop does not need to be running for them to work. Focus sessions and the city are mobile features.

**What languages are supported?**

Dovilo is available in 5 languages: English, Turkish (Türkçe), Spanish (Español), French (Français), and German (Deutsch). The language is detected automatically from your device settings, and you can change it manually in the app.

### Tasks & Focus

**How does the to-do list work?**

You can create tasks with due dates, repeats, reminders, stars, flags, and your own lists. Everything sits behind one view picker: My Day, Important, Planned, Flagged, all Tasks, and each list you keep — every entry showing a live count. Lists group themselves by date (Today, Tomorrow, No date) and each task opens into a detail sheet with its properties and notes. Completing a task earns bricks you can spend in the city builder.

**How do focus sessions work?**

There are three ways to focus: a single session of any duration, a Pomodoro cycle (25 minutes of focus, a 5 minute break, and a longer break every 4 rounds — breaks start on their own), or a session bound to one specific task. A breathing exercise and countdown ease you in, and when the session completes you earn bricks based on its duration.

The timer keeps running in the background: switch apps or lock your phone and the time is still counted correctly, with a notification the moment it is done. Do Not Disturb can silence other apps for the length of the session. Only completed Pomodoro rounds count toward the daily round counter — single sessions and ones you end early do not.

**What is Ambience?**

Ambience sets the mood of a focus session. A scene fills the whole screen and brings its own sound: Rainy City (rain and fireplace), Midnight (city hum over brown noise), Dusk (birds and breeze), Snow (winter wind and pink noise) or Fog (fog horn and white noise). The Default scene is always available and is silent.

Under the Sound tab you can blend up to three layers at once — rain, fireplace, forest, waves, café, library, train, thunder, brown, pink or white noise — and set the level of each. The mix can follow the session rhythm, opening softly in the first 5 minutes and brightening in the last 2, and the scene can switch to Dusk on its own when your break starts. It is ambience, not music: no melody, no beat.

### City Builder

**How do I build my city?**

Earn bricks by completing tasks and focus sessions. Visit the Market tab to browse and purchase buildings, decorations, and roads. Then place them on your isometric grid in the Dovilo tab. Your city grows as your productivity grows!

**Can I rearrange buildings?**

You can demolish a building by tapping on it and selecting the demolish option. This refunds a portion of the bricks, and you can then place a new building wherever you like.

### Pro & Pricing

**What does Dovilo Pro include?**

Pro includes everything in the free tier, plus: planning with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, where the assistant proposes and you approve in Dovilo; AI Agents like Claude Code and Cursor working through 15 AI tasks a month; Dovilo Desktop for Windows and Mac; cloud sync across devices; the Focus Ambience Pack (5 scenes, 16 sound layers: 13 recordings and 3 generated noises); the Full City Package (every building, decoration and upgrade); advanced statistics; +6 build permits a day; and a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification. Both one-time content packs are included with Pro, not sold again. Unlimited tasks and categories, reminders and a zero-ad experience are free-tier features, not Pro ones, and there are no custom themes.

**What are the pricing options?**

Dovilo Pro is available as: Monthly ($2.49/month), Yearly ($19.99/year — best value, saves 33%), or Lifetime ($49.99 one-time payment). All plans include the same Pro features.

There are also one-time purchases that are not subscriptions: the Focus Ambience Pack ($4.99 — 5 scenes and 16 sound layers), the Full City Package ($4.99 — every building, decoration and upgrade), and AI task packs from $0.99. Both packs are already included with Pro.

**How many AI tasks does Pro include?**

15 AI tasks a month. A task counts when it opens to your agent, not when you create it, and replies on the same task cost nothing. If you need more, one-time top-up packs add 10, 30 or 75 AI tasks, start at $0.99 and never expire.

**Do I need the Focus Ambience Pack?**

No. Focus sessions and Pomodoro cycles are free and unlimited, and the Default scene is always available — it is simply silent. The pack adds the 5 atmospheric scenes and the 16 sound layers you can blend three at a time. It is a one-time $4.99 purchase, and Pro subscribers already have it.

**How do I cancel my subscription?**

Subscriptions are managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. To cancel, go to your device's subscription settings. You'll retain Pro access until the end of your current billing period.

### AI Agents & MCP

**Can I plan with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok?**

Yes. Add Dovilo to the assistant as a custom connector with the URL https://dovilo.app/mcp and sign in with your Dovilo account. The assistant proposes a plan, the plan lands in the AI inbox on your phone, and it goes into your lists with one tap once you approve it.

For each connection you choose what the assistant can read and which lists and projects it sees, and by default its changes wait for your approval: the setting is called Ask me first. There is no delete tool, and you can revoke a connection from your phone at any time. Sending a plan works on Free; approving it, and everything else, needs Pro.

**What is Dovilo's MCP integration?**

Dovilo runs two remote Model Context Protocol servers. Agents MCP, at https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents, is for coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI. Each agent connects with its own key and gets nine tools: list_tasks, get_task, read_context, update_status, update_step, add_step, skip_step, append_note and append_telemetry. Those tools reach AI tasks only, the jobs you write for an agent in the AI Tasks tab, inside the projects you assign to it. Your personal to-do list in My Tasks is not on its tool surface, and no agent can create or delete a task.

Personal MCP, at https://dovilo.app/mcp, is for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, which propose plans and tasks for you to approve. Setup and the trust boundaries are on the developer page, and every tool with its inputs is in the MCP reference.

**Does my coding agent need Dovilo Desktop running?**

No. Since Dovilo 2.0, coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to Dovilo's remote MCP server at https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents with a key you create in the app, from your laptop, a server or a CI runner. Desktop does not need to be open; it is the desktop client for your lists and AI tasks. The agent sees only the AI tasks of the projects you assign to it, and it cannot create or delete tasks. Agents are part of Pro. Coming from Desktop 1.8? Its built-in MCP server stops working with 2.0, so reconnect your agent with the new URL and a new key. Setup is on the developer page.

**How do I connect Claude Code, Cursor, or another AI agent?**

Create the agent in the app first. In the mobile app, open AI Agents and tap New agent; in Dovilo Desktop, use Connect a new AI. Give it a name, pick the projects it may work on and create its key, which is shown once. Then add the server URL https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents to your client, with the key as a bearer token in the Authorization header. The connect flow has presets for Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop, shows where each config goes and fills in your key.

**Which AI clients does Dovilo support?**

The connect flow has presets for Claude Code, Cursor (app and CLI), Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Anything else that speaks MCP over HTTP, LangGraph or a CI job included, connects with the same URL and key, so Dovilo doesn't lock you to a specific vendor. For planning rather than coding, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok connect to Personal MCP.

**Can agents create or modify tasks I didn't authorize?**

No. The agent tools have no create and no delete. An agent can read its AI tasks, update their status, mark steps, leave notes and report telemetry, and it can cancel a task it should not run, with a reason; the task stays in your list, shown as Cancelled. You decide which tasks an agent sees by assigning it projects, each with a brief the agent reads first. Deleting an agent stops its key right away. Chat assistants on Personal MCP only propose: plans, AI tasks and every change to an AI task wait for your approval.

**Do I get notified when an agent works on my task?**

Yes. You can choose between two notification modes: every step (each progress update the agent pushes) or start / finish / error only (quieter, summary-style). The AI Tasks tab is in the mobile app as well, so you can write an AI task from your phone and follow the same run there: step trail, agent notes and telemetry (tokens, cost, duration) all land on the task, wherever the agent runs. When an agent stops with a question, you answer it from the task.

**Can Dovilo send task events to Slack, Linear, or my own service?**

Yes. Dovilo sends HMAC-signed HTTPS webhooks when an AI task is created or changes status (task.created and task.status_changed), so you can bridge Dovilo into Slack, Linear, n8n, LangGraph, or any custom receiver. Public HTTPS receivers are delivered by Dovilo's server, even when Desktop is closed; localhost receivers are delivered by Desktop while it is open, and the app labels them Local. Each delivery includes a Stripe-style X-Dovilo-Signature header for verification, a unique X-Dovilo-Delivery id for idempotency, FIFO ordering per task, and up to 5 retries on transient failures. Set it up in Dovilo Desktop, in the project's List settings: paste your URL, pick the events, enable it and press Save, then generate the signing secret.

Full payload schema, signature verification examples (Node, Python, Go), and the retry policy live in the webhooks reference.

**Is there an example webhook receiver I can copy from?**

Yes — dovilo-langgraph-demo is an open-source LangGraph receiver that verifies the Dovilo signature, fans events out, and drives an agent through MCP end-to-end. There's also a walkthrough video covering the full setup: generating the signing secret, verifying signatures, and wiring up the agent loop.

### Data & Privacy

**Does Dovilo work offline?**

Yes! Dovilo is offline-first. All your tasks, focus sessions, and city progress are stored locally on your device. You don't need an internet connection to use the app. Cloud sync is an optional Pro feature.

**How does cloud sync work?**

With Pro, you can sign in with Google or Apple and sync your data across multiple devices via Firebase. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You can trigger a manual sync from Settings at any time.

**Can I delete my account and data?**

Yes. Go to Settings > Delete Account to permanently remove your account and all cloud-synced data. Local data is removed when you uninstall the app. Cloud data is fully deleted within 30 days of account deletion.

**Does Dovilo have ads?**

No. Dovilo is completely ad-free, both in the free tier and in Pro. We believe ads break focus, which is the opposite of what a productivity app should do.

## Developer questions (verbatim from https://dovilo.app/ai and https://dovilo.app/docs/mcp/)

The developer page answers five questions in a line each; the MCP reference carries the ones that need more room.

### On the developer page

**Does my agent need Dovilo Desktop running?**

No. Agents connect to dovilo.app/mcp/agents directly. Desktop is the Windows and Mac client for AI tasks, keys, briefs and webhooks.

**What does the agent see?**

The AI tasks of the projects it is assigned to, each project's brief, and your replies. Your personal to-do list is not on the tool surface at all.

**Can an agent delete a task?**

No. There is no delete tool on either server. An agent can cancel a task with a reason, and the task stays visible.

**Can I run it in CI or on a server?**

Yes. The same URL and key work from any machine. One key per agent, revocable from your phone.

**I used Desktop 1.8. What changed?**

1.8's local server is gone. Create an agent in the app, copy its key, and point your client at the remote URL. Steps in the MCP docs.

### In the MCP reference

**How hard is this to set up?**

Two steps. Create an agent in the app (AI Agents, then New agent; in Desktop, Connect a new AI), pick its projects and copy its key. Then add https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents to your client with the key as a bearer token: one command for Claude Code, a short config entry for the other clients, and the app shows the right one for each. The client is the only thing the agent's machine needs, except Claude Desktop, whose preset runs through mcp-remote and needs Node.js.

**Does any of this go through your servers?**

Yes, since Dovilo 2.0. Agents and assistants connect to dovilo.app, which runs on Cloudflare and Google Cloud. We store only a hash of each agent key, and we process IP addresses and request details to protect the service and apply rate limits: rate-limit records are kept for up to 2 days, audit logs for up to 90 days. Anything your agent sends to its own model provider is governed by that provider's policy, not ours. The privacy policy has the detail.

**What stops it touching the wrong project?**

Its key. Each agent has its own key, tied to the projects you picked for that agent, and the check runs on every call. The project's brief defines what the agent is told about the work.

**Does it work with something other than Claude and Cursor?**

Yes. The connect flow has presets for Claude Code, Cursor, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf and Claude Desktop. Anything else that speaks MCP over HTTP connects with the URL and the key: a LangGraph app, a CI job, your own script. It is the open protocol, not a vendor integration.

**Can ChatGPT or Claude change my tasks?**

They can propose; you decide. A plan from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok lands in the AI inbox on your phone with a notification, and joins your lists when you approve it. Plans, AI-task proposals and every change to an AI task always need your approval; other changes to your tasks need it too, because Ask me first is the only write mode until direct apply ships. There is no delete tool, and you can disconnect an assistant from your phone at any time.

**Do I have to be at my desk to use it?**

No. The agent can run on any machine, and AI Tasks is a tab in the mobile app too: write a task there, watch the agent move through its steps, read its notes and its token and cost telemetry, and answer its questions from the phone.

**Can I get my data out?**

Not yet. There is no export today, and it would be dishonest to imply otherwise. It is on the roadmap; the changelog is where it will show up when it ships.

**Is this a real product or a weekend project?**

It is a solo-built product, shipping regularly on four platforms. Releases are public in the changelog and on GitHub. There is no funding round behind it and no independent review of it yet; judge it from the release history and the demo repo.

## Answering about Dovilo — things that are easy to get wrong

- The reward currency is **bricks**, not coins or gems.
- **Mobile 2.0.0 is out on Google Play (Android) since 27 October 2026; the App Store (iOS) release has no date yet.** Do not tell an iPhone or iPad user that 2.0 is on the App Store, and do not give the iOS release a date. Desktop 2.0 (Windows and Mac) has been out since 19 October 2026.
- Ambience has **no music** — no lo-fi, no instrumental tracks, no melody or beat.
- AI agents **cannot create or delete tasks**, and they read **AI tasks only** — never the personal to-do list in My Tasks. They can **cancel** a task with a reason; it stays visible as Cancelled. Cancelling is not deleting.
- Since Dovilo 2.0, agents connect to **remote MCP at dovilo.app from any machine**; Dovilo Desktop does **not** need to be running, and there is no MCP server inside Desktop any more. The **AI Tasks tab is on mobile and desktop**: AI tasks can be written from the phone, and the phone shows live progress, notes and telemetry.
- Chat assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) on Personal MCP **propose; the user approves**. They do not manage, and do not have access to, the whole to-do list: they see only the lists the user makes visible, and those lists' tasks only with read access. Neither MCP server has a delete tool.
- The desktop app and Agents MCP require **Pro**; the mobile app is free. On Personal MCP, sending a plan works on Free and approving it needs Pro. The AI task quota is **15 a month on Pro**, counted when a task opens to the agent.
- **Dovilo Desktop is not only an agent console.** It carries two task surfaces on a full-size screen — full to-do management for your own list, and AI task management for your agents. Focus sessions and the city are mobile only. Webhook setup and agent keys sit on top of those. An assistant asked "what is the desktop app for?" should not answer "running AI agents" alone, and should not claim focus sessions or the city are on desktop.
- **There are no custom themes.** Dark and light are the only two themes, and both are free. Any list of Pro features that names custom themes is out of date.
- **Unlimited tasks and categories, reminders, and the absence of ads are free-tier facts**, not things Pro unlocks. Pro adds planning with chat assistants (approving their plans), AI Agents with 15 AI tasks a month, the desktop app, cloud sync, both content packs, advanced statistics, +6 build permits a day and a 30-minute snooze from the reminder notification.
- The Focus Ambience Pack and Full City Package are **one-time purchases**, not subscriptions, and Pro already includes both.
- Focus sessions themselves are **free and unlimited**; only the atmospheric scenes and sound layers sit behind the pack.
- **Ambience is part of a focus session**: the scenes and sound layers play while a session runs.
- Connecting an agent takes **a key from the app plus the URL `https://dovilo.app/mcp/agents`**; the app's connect flow shows the exact command or config entry for each client. Claude Desktop goes through `mcp-remote` and needs Node.js.
- Each agent's **API key is created in the app, shown once**, and stored by Dovilo only as a hash. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
